title: Shifted $\pm 1$ vectors are nonzero for $\alpha < 1$
statement: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $\alpha$ be a real number with $0 \le \alpha < 1$. Then for every binary word $x$ of length $n$, the shifted vector $\hat{x}^\alpha \in \bbr^n$ — obtained from the $\pm 1$ embedding of $x$ by subtracting $\alpha$ times the all-ones vector — is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: x an arbitrary binary word of length n
replaced:
If $n > 0$ and $0 \le \alpha < 1$, then $\hat{x}^\alpha \neq 0$ for every binary word
$x$ of length $n$.
